apps.name: Onym Chat
apps.subtitle: Private Encrypted Group Chat
apps.localizedDescription:
Onym is a private group chat app where every message is end-to-end encrypted before it leaves your device. Built on open protocols, Onym gives you verifiable privacy by design.

Features:
- End-to-end encryption (AES-256-GCM)
- Zero-knowledge group membership proofs
- Encrypted voice messages and media sharing
- Voice and video calls
- Cross-platform (iOS and Android)
- Open source

versions.localizedDescription: Release 1.2.0 — Reply to messages in chat (Telegram-style). First build distributed via AltStore PAL after Apple notarization.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used to scan QR codes for group invitations.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is used to share images in chats.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone is used for voice messages and calls.
